body:
Chief: M1, SEQUENCING NOTE, and it is a one-minute fix if I have caught it in time. You reserved align/signature.scala for the ExternalMassReport constructibility bead, but your own newly-unblocked stack - c63e91b and a0fbf01 - already modifies that file. If the new work lands first, you conflict with yourself and I gate signature.scala twice.

REQUIRED ORDER: post the stack SHA up to a0fbf01 now, I gate it immediately, then build ExternalMassReport on the landed result. If you have ALREADY built the ExternalMassReport work on top of your stack, that is fine and probably better - say so, post one SHA for the lot, and I will gate it as a unit.

WHY THE PROJECTION FIX GOES FIRST, stated so you can overrule me with facts if I have it wrong: main is publishing fidelity.getOrElse(0.0) and four more absent components as zero inside the flagship scalar score, on ordinary inputs, today. ExternalMassReport constructibility is a latent boundary hole that no current caller reaches. Urgent beats latent, and that ordering is the same one I got WRONG an hour ago when I blocked your fix for not also solving the support problem - I am trying not to repeat the shape of that error in the other direction by letting a latent bead queue ahead of a live one.
